_note: Region data for area-type items of 24S-B. RAW_SCHEMA has no `region` field, so it lives here. Ids are built question ids. X,Y independent U(0,1) (unit square); S = XY, L = sqrt(X^2+Y^2).

24S-B-Q1a.distribution: uniform on the unit square (X, Y independent U(0,1))
24S-B-Q1a.eventBoundary: hyperbola y = 1/(2x), meeting the top edge at x = 1/2

24S-B-Q1b.distribution: uniform on the unit square (X, Y independent U(0,1))

24S-B-Q1c.distribution: uniform on the unit square (X, Y independent U(0,1))
24S-B-Q1c.areaFormula: (1/5)*ln(2) (area of the event inside the conditioning region)
